clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound, Abercrombie's Crate lies abandoned after ogres drove off its owner. The crate holds delicate tools and gathered herbs belonging to the eccentric hermit.

Abercrombie left his shack in western Duskwood to gather vegetation. Far from home, he met a hostile band of ogres and fled for his life, leaving behind his crate of instruments and harvested plants. The ogres carried it to the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound, where the heavy chest rests near the cave mouth.
